title: Capsules! (Simple Potions)
description: Capsules! Mod adds simpler/early game potions in the form of capsules!
body:
# Capsules!
This mod adds simpler/early game versions 
of some potions in the form of capsules!

**How does it work?**
This mod lets you craft capsules that stack up to 16. Eating one gives you 1 minute of the potion effect. The capsules are crafted using 1x copper ingot, 1x sugar + 1x potion specific item. Each craft gives 4x capsules!

Current featured effects(effect item) are:
- Night Vision(Golden Carrot)
- Jump Boost/Leaping(Rabbit's Foot)
- Slow Falling(Phantom Membrane)
- Water Breathing(Pufferfish)
- Speed/Swiftness(Sugar)
- Invisibility(Fermented Spider Eye)
- Fire Resistance(Magma Cream)
- Strength(Blaze Powder)
- Regeneration(Ghast Tear)
